sections.title: At the Café
sections.content: Ordering runs on a handful of words: the thing you want, the person serving you, and the bill at the end. Spanish nouns carry an article — 'el' for masculine, 'la' for feminine — and it is worth learning the two together, because the article is the easiest way to remember which a noun is.
'Por favor' goes at the end of the request, not the beginning: 'La cuenta, por favor.'
